senior: introduced new process adopted across org

credible: delivered project of N engineers, $X budget, Y week timeline
introduced async standup format that cut meeting time by N hours/week
managed cross-functional dependencies across N teams
ran retrospective program adopted by N teams
mitigated risk X by introducing checkpoint Y

common_interview_topics: handling missed deadlines and stakeholder communication
tool stack experience (Jira, Asana, Linear, etc)
agile vs waterfall — when to use which
must_have_signals: concrete project size + outcomes (people, budget, timeline)
examples of risk identification and mitigation
common_red_flags_for_seniority: claims senior PM but only describes process facilitation, not outcome ownership
no quantified delivery (no people counts, no budget, no timeline)
lists certifications (PMP, Scrum Master) without applied examples
framing_opportunities: if candidate ran weekly status meetings, reframe as 'instituted reporting cadence that surfaced N risks early'
if candidate used Jira, frame the actual workflow they designed there
if candidate dealt with conflict, surface specific resolution outcome
